tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the app grid and the main scroll area. Text on it: text, muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Topbar, sidebar, ticket panel, cards, modals, inputs and resting buttons.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second-level fill: table row hover, stat tiles, server cards, suggested-question buttons, the head and foot of the live queue.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: panel dividers, card and input borders, table rows. Decorative only (1.25:1 on surface), never the sole sign of a control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-2 and bubble (14:1 or better in both themes). Also the inverted fill of the primary desk card.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, table headers, resting nav items and icons, on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.5:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive hue: primary buttons, links, active nav and tab, focus border, selected rows' text, the logo. As text on surface, bg or accent-soft (5:1+).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: active nav, selected table row, segmented and tab 'on', badge counts, the focus halo.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (primary button, ribbon, my chat bubble). Source keeps white in dark too: 2.85:1 on the dark accent, below AA. Flagged, kept exact.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Resolved, healthy, passed: status pills, OK dots and LEDs, score ring A/B, the ✓ in feedback lists. As text on good-soft (4.45:1 light, just under AA; 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind good text: resolved pill, live call bar, active session pill, low priority.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: SLA due soon, on hold, voicemail, degraded nodes, high meters. As text on warn-soft or surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text and behind high and medium priority badges; the ringing-call row on the live queue.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Breach, error, locked, penalties: SLA breach, reopened, critical alerts, the danger button, the ✕ in feedback. As text on bad-soft or surface (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind bad text: critical priority, reopened pill, critical alert, late call bar.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Priority P1 (Critical) text and the first segment of the brand stripe. On bad-soft (5.7:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: high
tokens.usage: Priority P2 (High) text and stripe segment. On warn-soft: 3.89:1 in light, below AA for 10.5px text. Flagged, kept exact.

tokens.name: med
tokens.usage: Priority P3 (Medium) text and stripe segment; 'waiting on approval/vendor' statuses. On warn-soft: 4.45:1 light (just under AA), 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: low
tokens.usage: Priority P4 (Low) text and stripe segment. On good-soft: 4.49:1 light (just under AA), 8.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Requester chat bubbles and calendar job blocks. Text on it: text.

tokens.name: p1
tokens.usage: Landing alias for Critical: the queue's priority bar, the hero's <em>, the alert dot on the timeline.

tokens.name: p2
tokens.usage: Landing alias for High: the ringing-call icon and 'Ringing' label.

tokens.name: p3
tokens.usage: Landing alias for Medium.

tokens.name: p4
tokens.usage: Landing alias for Low.

tokens.name: int
tokens.usage: Coordinator mode: internal-note chat bubbles (never seen by the client). Text on it: text.

tokens.name: int-border
tokens.usage: Coordinator mode: the border of an internal-note bubble.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Coordinator mode: the diagonal hatch on off-shift cells of the dispatch board.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal overlay behind a dialog, both themes.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast background, the same in both themes. Text: white (15.9:1).

tokens.name: toast-info
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, default (accent) tone.

tokens.name: toast-good
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, success.

tokens.name: toast-bad
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, error or penalty.

tokens.name: toast-warn
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, information that needs attention.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo from Google Fonts (variable: wdth 62–125, wght 400–800). Start screens only. Widths are set with font-stretch: 118% hero, 112% sections, 108% desk titles.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Your queue is already filling up.
styles.usage: Start-screen headline (clamp 38–62px, font-stretch 118%). One <em> word in p1.

styles.name: section
styles.sample: 11 tickets, and some of them are traps.
styles.usage: Landing section headings (clamp 26–36px, font-stretch 112%), max 24ch.

styles.name: desk-title
styles.usage: Desk and shift card names (font-stretch 108%).

styles.name: report-title
styles.usage: Example report heading on the landing page.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: You're the new service desk technician at Brightline Logistics.
styles.usage: The paragraph under the hero, max 34em, in muted with <b> in text.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The app runs on the platform UI face at a 14px base. Headings are bold (700) by browser default.

styles.name: app-hero
styles.usage: Report and pricing hero titles (clamp 30–46px).

styles.name: view-title
styles.usage: The title of each tool view (Queue, Directory, Server room) and KB article titles.

styles.name: user-name

styles.name: card-title
